name: Mini-PREVis
description: This study validates a short-form (3 items), unidimensional visualization perceived readability scale. It is derived via Schmid-Leiman decomposition from the 29 Perceived Readability Evaluation in Visualization questionnaire (PREVis) initial candidate item pool. In this validation study, participants will rate 6 data visualization stimuli on the new short scale, the full 4-subscale PREVis instrument, and BeauVis, alongside two reading tasks per stimulus.
